translations.web: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
translations.bsb: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.
translations.kjv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
translations.asv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And markest all my paths; Thou settest a bound to the soles of my feet:
